column7: structural half of stale-secret-save-001/002/003 (#2695), a DERIVED sweep rather than a per-function guard: it walks every non-test file under internal/core, internal/storage/store and server/ and asserts nothing calls the full-row storage.UpdateSecret, with exactly ONE named allowance (SetSecretAutoRotate, which is #2650's site and is moved by open PR #2668). It discriminates the storage method from the identically-named exported core method by RECEIVER shape, with the recognised set stated explicitly so it is itself reviewable, and it fails in BOTH directions -- a new caller appearing, and the allowance going stale once #2668 lands. Companions: TestUpdateSecretWrites_AreColumnScoped (the LocalStorage body plus all eight call sites) and TestUpdateSecretRequest_FieldSetsMatch (applyUpdateSecretFields and secretFieldUpdateFromRequest must read the same request fields, since a field wired into only one is silently either never-persisted or not-reflected)
